variant_notes: AF A-6 is the 1928-29 refit card. The later 1941-45 Colorado refits are transcribed in dated_remarks only; this profile is the printed card configuration.

Same catalog class as Colorado but a separate CAS card (AF A-4, 1944 rebuild). It is not merged into the Colorado (1929) profile: the guns, secondary battery, gunnery standard and sensors differ on the printed cards.

AF C-3 prints two APC rows under 'Mk2, 3 16in/50'. The second row is used for the Mk3 card; the first row is recorded here so the ambiguity is not hidden: 8500/22000/35600/44500 yd, pen 82/59/41/32, damage 46/36/31/27.
The 16in/50 shell is the 2240 lb APC of the 1924 design. No separate 1944-45 refit card exists for this never-completed class.

AF A-14 prints the 1929 class card with Gunnery Standard III and a 4×5in/25 secondary. Houston's own Form 10 p.249 is the Feb 42 modification: GS IV, 8×5in/25, 3×3in/50. The profile follows the Form 10.
Form 10 p.249 8in/55 APC prints damage 25/19/16/14; AF C-3 prints 23/18/15/13 for the same gun row. The ship uses the Form 10 values.

AF A-16 is the 1923 class card (12×6in/53, 4×3in/50, 10 torpedo tubes). The late-1930s/1942 refits (8×3in/50, torpedo tubes removed, radar) are transcribed in dated_remarks but are not the printed card configuration.
RS Form 10 p.268 is Marblehead (Omaha class, Dec 1941), a different hull with a different 6in fit; it is not used for Omaha/Memphis.
AF A-19 prints Displacement 1160/1120, Crew 114/100 and two DP rows. The profile uses the Clemson (1120 t, crew 100, DP 78) values; the Wickes variant is 1160 t, crew 114, DP 0/20/40/60/72/80.

RS Form 10 p.346 (Edsall, Clemson, Dec 1941) is a single-hull cross-check: 1090 t, crew 153, DP 0/19/39/58/69/77, Gunnery Standard II, 2×1pdr. It is not used as the class card because the AF card is the class-level annex row; the discrepancy is registered.

RS Form 10 p.346 also prints 4in/50 COM short-range damage 14 (AF C-1 prints 13) and Mk8 torpedo 75 DP (AF F-1 prints 72). The ship follows the AF C-1/F-1 annex rows; the Form 10 values are registered but not used.
AF A-19/A-20 give no radar and no 20mm for the printed 1918 fit. The 1941 refit data is in dated_remarks.

classes.catalog_label_note: catalog legacy label usn-4in-dd is wrong for DD-351: the actual class is Farragut (AF A-19, 5in/38, 8 Mk15 tubes).
variant_notes: catalog 的 usn-4in-dd 是错标签；DD-351 是 Farragut 级，按 AF A-19 重建，不再使用 Clemson/Wickes 4in 卡。
Savo 的 us_farragut_dd 与 AF A-19 原页冲突（DP 36 vs 26、speed 26 vs 27、ASW w/6 vs w/7），本卡按 AF A-19 原页修正；详见 savo_cross_check。
Savo runtime savo_dewey/savo_hull 把 Farragut 标成 size C / turn 300；AF A-19 与 Savo 的 profile 都写 D/Small，本卡按 D / 200 yd / 1 kt。
The only J/K/N-class Form 10 in the checked source is Jupiter (Dec 1941). It is reused as the class profile for the five catalog identities; no per-hull 1942-43 fit is invented.
The RS class index (p.13) lists Jupiter as page 33, but the actual card is PDF page 32 (page 33 is Electra). The name index (p.19) correctly says 32.

AF F-1 prints Mk15 87 DP (TNT) for the 1935-42 rows and a 1943 Torpex 99 DP row. The ship uses the registered 87 DP TNT row; the Torpex alternative is registered but not used, because the card does not date Gearing's torpedo lot.
The damage table 0/41/81/122/146/162 and speed 36/27/18/9/0 are printed at the top of A-17 and belong to the Gearing card begun on A-16.
